cohort: The study included 100 pregnant women admitted for childbirth, divided into a normal group (40 cases) and a preeclampsia group (60 cases).
finding: The study found that Cd exposure and accumulation in the maternal-fetal system can impact Zn transport and metabolism in the placenta, leading to increased FOXO3a expression under oxidative stress, which contributes to the development of preeclampsia.
